title: Stickman survival: lost in the forest

characters.description: stickman hiker named Sam with a green backpack and an orange beanie
small stickman-style owl with big round eyes and a tiny brown scarf

scenes.narration: Sam is lost in the forest, and the sun is going down.
scenes.image_prompt: lone hiker standing in a dark pine forest at sunset, looking worried

scenes.narration: Rule number one: stop walking. Panic makes you wander farther from help.
scenes.image_prompt: hiker sitting on a log, hand raised in a stop gesture, calm expression

scenes.narration: A wise old owl watches him from a branch.
scenes.image_prompt: owl perched on a branch above the hiker, forest at dusk

scenes.narration: Rule two: build a shelter before dark. Lean branches against a fallen log.
scenes.image_prompt: hiker leaning branches against a fallen log to make a lean-to shelter

scenes.narration: Rule three: make noise and signals. Three whistles mean help.
scenes.image_prompt: hiker blowing a whistle, sound waves, owl nearby

scenes.narration: Stay warm, stay visible, and stay put.
scenes.image_prompt: hiker sitting by a small campfire under the stars, owl beside him

scenes.narration: At sunrise, rescuers follow the whistle and find Sam safe.
scenes.image_prompt: rescuers with flashlights arriving at the shelter at dawn, hiker waving happily
